scope_note: Read-only review of sandbox sple (before spon3) for 0001646614 against the 13 cached filings. Scripts and outputs: scratch/fund_runs/0001646614/reviewer_sple/. Full-population scans, not samples: printed industry (ind_check.py, 2,020 rows), printed currency (fx_check.py, 1,931 rows), printed reference-rate code (rr_check.py, 1,930 rows), printed negative cost (cost_sign.py). Not checked: non-accrual flags, acquisition dates and pct of net assets row by row; the 2026 cost residues; the 20-row random page sample. A clean ledger would not establish data correctness.

checks_requested.a_gics_aliases: Partly supported. Printed industry is published as printed for 2,015 of 2,020 rows; two rows carry a member industry that differs from the page (Wesco 2023-12-31 -> Health Care Services; Gibson 2025-09-30 -> Household Products). Cross-fund: 'power generation' will relabel Ares Capital (v0.5, 148 rows) and 0001918712 (19 rows) to Independent Power Producers & Energy Traders on the next build; unmeasured. Several other keys are broad enough to mislabel future filers. See the industry observation.
checks_requested.b_foreign_par: Supported. All located rows carry the printed currency; USD par = par x H.10 rate; rates equal the cached H.10 series.
checks_requested.c_nav_split: Supported for 2022-12-31 to 2026-06-30, each equal to its own filing. 2023-03-31 (14.39) unverifiable from cache; 2020-12-31 (30.00) not read.
checks_requested.d_reference_rates: Partly supported. Printed codes match on 1,901 of 1,930 located lines; three fixed-coupon rows at 2024-12-31 (Wesco, Takko GmbH, Takko Sarl) are still Floating/SOFR with spread = coupon. Separate pre-existing defect: SP-CREH loans publish interest_rate 5.00 (the cap) instead of the printed rate from 2023-12-31.
checks_requested.e_proposals: A04/E01 x18, C04, A01, Amerijet (X02, financial_convention_unresolved), maturity_not_past, F27: factually right on the page. B01: the listed contexts are right but the statement and coverage omit the 7/7/13 comparative-period contexts in the rule's residual.
checks_requested.f_orchestrator_keys: Supported: the cash anchor now equals the printed cash total from filed concepts, the subtotal patterns only match issuerless printed subtotals, and the cost split compares like with like; each has negative tests (50 passed, reviewer run). None hides a real error, but the cost check's 5 pct band leaves the 2023 cost-sign error invisible.

additional_defects_found: Cost sign 2023: 47 unfunded lines (12/15/20 at 2023-06-30/09-30/12-31) publish positive cost where the page prints negative; equals the reported cost residue exactly.
Three fixed-coupon rows at 2024-12-31 published Floating/SOFR (contexts C_7b384fb0..., C_74c5abc0..., C_fb2a1d67...).
SP-CREH 19 Highline loans: interest_rate 5.00 (cap) published from 2023-12-31; printed/tagged 7.00, 6.53, 6.38, 5.84, 5.67.
Industry from member differs from print on Wesco 2023-12-31 and Gibson 2025-09-30.
Issuer names with superscript footnote residue (BayMark 2026-06-30, OLA 2024-09-30); one money-market name not as printed (2025-06-30 onward).
Global alias 'power generation' changes Ares Capital and 0001918712 labels; cohort diff not run.

observation_reviews.rationale: Mostly right, two claims fail. (1) 'Reads the printed industry': reviewer scan of all 2,020 non-cash sple rows with an extracted industry against the printed schedule line finds the label on the line for 2,015 (1 name not located; Sintec differs only by the printed colon). Two rows publish the member's industry where the page prints another: Wesco Aircraft senior secured bonds 2023-12-31 (C_818ef837..., 15.8M) member 'Healthcare Providers & Services', page 'Industrial Products & Services', now published Health Care Services (spon3 had Aerospace & Defense); Gibson Brands 2025-09-30 (C_f2fc77ed..., 4.7M) member 'Consumer Products', page 'Consumer Brands', published Household Products. industry_coverage cannot see this class (it counts blanks). (2) 'Shared aliases, none lose a label': true for this fund, but the alias table is global and printed_industry_gics lets an alias override the label cache. In the 2026-10-18 regression builds of the 53 accepted funds (scratch/fund_sandbox/rgA1..rgA6) two other funds print a label the new aliases catch: Ares Capital (0001287750, a v0.5 fund) 'Power Generation' on 148 rows now labelled Renewable Electricity, and 0001918712 'Power Generation' on 19 rows now Electric Utilities. On the next build all 167 become Independent Power Producers & Energy Traders (same Utilities sector; Ares' Sunrun/Heelstone/Apex rows lose the more precise Renewable Electricity, Ferrellgas is neither). The cohort effect was not measured, contrary to the global-fix rule. The other 13 aliases match no other fund in those builds, but several are broad keys that would mislabel other filers' rows on arrival: 'transportation and logistics' -> Air Freight & Logistics (trucking, rail, marine), 'e commerce' -> Broadline Retail (e-commerce software), 'gaming and entertainment' -> Casinos & Gaming (non-gaming entertainment), 'insurance and insurance services' -> Insurance Brokers (carriers); within this fund 'Industrial Products & Services' -> Industrial Machinery puts Covanta, Wesco Aircraft, 48Forty and Stryten in one machinery sub-industry, and 'Staples Retail' -> Consumer Staples Merchandise Retail for a grocer (Tops) where Food Retail is the GICS fit. Needed: restrict these aliases to this filer (per-CIK label map) or measure and accept the cohort diff; add a member-versus-printed industry check.
